The '''Vendusii Crystal''' was a type of [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]]<ref name="HR" /> and amorphous [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstone]]<ref name="SWG:AG" /> that originated in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Vendusii system/Legends|Vendusii system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Vendusii sector/Legends|Vendusii sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Vendusii Crystals could be obtained in [[Mining/Legends|mines]], and their quality could be expressed in gradations such as Level-001. At one point, a highly skilled&mdash;yet very stubborn&mdash;[[Svivreni]] [[Unidentified Svivreni mineralogist|freelance mineralogist]] who was active several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|formation]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]<ref name="HR" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> appraised the potential of a mine owned by the executive [[D'gaat]]. The [[Mineralogist/Legends|mineralogist]] disagreed with D'gaat and confidently claimed that only Level-001 Vendusii Crystals would be produced by the mining operation.<ref name="HR" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:WEG_HeroesandRogues.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Vendusii Crystal was introduced in ''Heroes & Rogues''.]]
The Vendusii Crystal was first mentioned in the [[1995]] sourcebook ''[[Heroes & Rogues]]'', authored by [[Rick D. Stuart|Rick Stuart]] and [[Paul Sudlow]] and published for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="HR" /> Vendusii Crystals later appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony|Sony Online Entertainment]] and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

In the game, Vendusii Crystals were a type of [[W:c:swg:Resource|resource]] that could be used by [[W:c:swg:Crafting|crafters]] to create items. Vendusii Crystals were one of the many types of [[W:c:swg:Amorphous gemstone|amorphous gemstone]] that could be obtained by [[W:c:swg:Harvester|harvesting]] the soil of the game's worlds. The type of gemstones collected during harvesting was determined randomly, and all varieties of amorphous gemstones were interchangeable and had similar characteristics. Like other resources in the game, Vendusii Crystals were only represented visually as a generic crate of resources.<ref name="SWG:AG" /> In the real world, [[Wikipedia:Crystal|crystals]] and [[Wikipedia:Amorphous solid|amorphous solids]] are mutually exclusive categories of [[Wikipedia:Solid|solid matter]];<ref name="AmorphousBritannica">{{WebCite|url=https://www.britannica.com/science/amorphous-solid|text=Amorphous solid &#124; Properties, Structure & Examples|author=The Editors of Encyclopædia Britannica|date=2023-05-06|work=[[Wikipedia:Encyclopædia Britannica|''Encyclopædia Britannica'']]|archivedate=20241206125320}}</ref> nevertheless, for example, the misnomers "lead crystal" or just "crystal" are also sometimes used to describe [[Wikipedia:Lead glass|lead glass]], which is a type of [[Wikipedia:Glass|glass]]<ref name="LeadGlassBritannica">{{WebCite|url=https://www.britannica.com/technology/flint-glass|text=Flint glass &#124; Optical, Refractive, Hardened|author=The Editors of Encyclopædia Britannica|date=2022-09-13|work=[[Wikipedia:Encyclopædia Britannica|''Encyclopædia Britannica'']]|archivedate=20241007181053}}</ref> and therefore amorphous and not crystalline.<ref name="AmorphousBritannica" />
